render.stationsManifestPrelude: # atari800xl (slot 186) — Atari 800XL, host-native MAME a800xlp, boot menu of period software; atari800xl wave 2026-09-08.

museum.blurb: The Atari 8-bit most people owned: a 64 KB 800XL with Atari BASIC in ROM, a 1050 disk drive on the SIO bus and a joystick on port 1. The disk boots straight into a menu — Star Raiders, Boulder Dash, Dropzone, River Raid, The Last Word word processor, and Atari BASIC to type into.
museum.notes: Host-native station: MAME 0.289's a800xlp driver (Atari 800XL, PAL) runs on the host — drawshm frames, ctlsock keys, FIFO audio, no QEMU and no guest OS. -flop1 is hive.atr, a 133 KB enhanced-density MyDOS disk composed on the host by scripts/build-guests/tiles/atari800xl.sh; its boot sector is MyPicoDos 4.06N, whose boot screen IS the file menu (RETURN loads the highlighted entry, ~15 s per title). Keyboard-only exhibit (pointer transport none), like apple2e, with a CX40 joystick on -ctrl1 driven from the host arrow keys and Left Alt as fire; F1/F2/F3 are the Start/Select/Option console keys. The machine has no cursor keys — menu navigation is CTRL held across - = + *. See docs/lab/ATARI800XL-WAVE.md.

reset.mouse: N/A — keyboard-only exhibit (pointer transport none); see the wave brief's OPEN items
reset.keyboard: PARTIALLY VERIFIED, re-confirmed on single density by the golden-fix stream 2026-09-08 at the fleet-floor 40/40 ms pacing (MAME_CTL_KEY_HOLD/GAP), no MAME_CTL_KEY_EXCL: menu-highlight navigation is PROVEN over ctlsock through the real keymap fields (:ctrl1:joy:JOY P1 Up/Down, the same mapping the PC arrow keys already carry) -- the bar visibly moves entry-to-entry and back, no dropped or duplicated input observed. STILL OPEN, RE-TESTED on the rebuilt single-density disk (golden-fix stream, 2026-09-08): RETURN on the highlighted entry still does not reliably commit a load (single tap, 500ms hold, and a second RETURN 2s later were all tried -- the file list transiently clears then the menu returns pixel-unchanged), the SAME symptom as before the density fix, which disproves that enhanced density alone explained it -- this is a separate, still-unresolved bug. Per-title first-screen proofs (Boulder Dash, Star Raiders mission-select, the XBASIC BASIC-prompt typing proof) and the D2: switch to Dropzone remain UNVERIFIED. See docs/lab/ATARI800XL-WAVE.md ## Walls hit and ## Proofs.
reset.fixture: Atari 800XL, MAME 0.289 a800xlp running HOST-NATIVE (drawshm). MyPicoDos 4.06N boot menu on D1: (hive.atr, SINGLE density -- rebuilt 2026-09-08, MAME's emulated 1050 has no enhanced-density support) lists BOULDER.XEX, LASTWORD.XEX, LW.CFG, RIVRRAID.XEX, STARRAID.XEX, XBASIC.XEX; highlight starts on BOULDER.XEX. Dropzone (DROPZONE.XEX) moved to a second single-density drive hive2.atr (D2:, -flop2). Cold boot MEASURED 2026-09-08: directory fully painted by mtime~19s. Reset is a relaunch that restores sta/a800xlp/golden.sta (rebaked 2026-09-08 on the new disk pair); the restore was proven PIXEL-IDENTICAL to the pre-capture frame (PIL bbox None), 206ms ctlsock-ready after relaunch vs. the ~19 s cold boot. Menu navigation (PC arrows -> joystick Up/Down, no chord needed) is verified; RETURN-to-load a title is STILL OPEN, confirmed independent of density (see reset.keyboard).
